item.text: A single ride on the Kyiv Metro costs **30 UAH**; [the Kyiv City Portal](https://kyivcity.gov.ua/news/iz_15_lipnya_vartist_razovogo_prozdu_v_komunalnomu_transporti_stanovitime_30_grn_dlya_postiynikh_pasazhiriv_diyatime_sistema_znizhok/) says the fare took effect on 15 July 2026.
